mLocKeys.keySummary: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Malphite slams the ground, dealing <magicDamage>@EDamageCalc@ magic damage</magicDamage> and reducing <attackSpeed>Attack Speed by @ASReduction@%</attackSpeed> for @Duration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ground Slam Debuff</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's Attack Speed is reduced.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Granite Shield</titleLeft><mainText>After not taking damage for <font color='#FFFFFF'>@f2@</font> seconds Malphite summons a shield of rock that absorbs <font color='#CC3300'>@f1@</font> (10% of his maximum Health) damage.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Malphite grants himself <shield>@TotalShield@ Shield</shield> after not taking damage for @PassiveCooldown@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Thunderclap</titleLeft><mainText>Malphite's basic attacks deal damage to enemies in a cone.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Granite Shield</titleLeft><mainText>Malphite is surrounded by a wall of stone, absorbing incoming damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Thunderclap</titleLeft><mainText>Malphite's next basic attack deals heavy bonus damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Malphite attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom. For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Malphite gains @BonusArmorPassive*100@% Armor (%i:scaleArmor%@f1@). This effect is increased to @BonusArmorPassive*300@% (%i:scaleArmor%@f2@) while Granite Shield is active.

Active: Malphite's next Attack deals an additional @TotalBonusDamage@ physical damage and creates an aftershock which deals @ThunderclapSplash@ physical damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit in their direction. His Attacks continue to create aftershocks %i:OnHit% On-Hit for the next @ThunderclapBuffDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Seismic Shard</titleLeft><mainText>Malphite has stolen a unit's Move Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Malphite launches a shard of earth at an enemy, dealing <magicDamage>@QDamageCalc@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> them by @SpeedSteal@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds. Malphite also steals the amount <status>Slowed</status>, gaining it as <speed>Move Speed</speed> for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Seismic Shard Slow</titleLeft><mainText>Malphite has stolen this unit's Move Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Malphite charges with the force of a landslide, dashing Unstoppably. At the end of the dash, Malphite <status>Knocks Up</status> for @KnockupDuration@ seconds and deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
